newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bakrie Indonesia BV to launch US$125 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie Indonesia BV to launch US$125 mln FRN.

text.p: The following issue was announced by arranger and bookrunner Sumitomo Finance (Asia).
The arranger is inviting banks to join as co-arrangers and underwriters.
The guarantor of the issue, Bakrie Investindo, owns part of the Indonesian listed company Bakrie and Brothers.
